common.title: Common Pests & Diseases
common.aphidsDesc: Small sap-sucking insects that cluster on new growth
common.aphidsSymptoms: Curled leaves, Sticky residue, Ant activity, Stunted growth
common.aphidsTreatment: Spray with neem oil or insecticidal soap. Remove heavily infested parts.
common.whitefliesDesc: Small white flying insects that feed on plant sap
common.whitefliesSymptoms: Yellowing leaves, White powdery coating, Leaf drop, Sooty mold
common.whitefliesTreatment: Use yellow sticky traps and apply neem oil. Maintain good air circulation.
common.spiderMitesDesc: Tiny arachnids that cause stippling and webbing on leaves
common.spiderMitesSymptoms: Yellow stippling, Fine webbing, Leaf bronzing, Premature leaf drop
common.spiderMitesTreatment: Increase humidity and spray with water. Apply miticide if severe.
common.thripsDesc: Small slender insects that scrape plant tissue
common.thripsSymptoms: Silver streaks, Deformed flowers, Black fecal spots, Stunted growth
common.thripsTreatment: Remove weeds and debris. Apply spinosad or neem oil treatments.
common.leafRustDesc: Fungal disease causing orange-brown pustules on leaves
